fullDescription: A warm, friendly FAQ / help-center page on a cream base built around one sunset gradient (coral->amber): a sticky blurred nav, a centered hero with a gradient-clipped 'We've got answers.' headline + a 'FAQ & HELP CENTER' pill over a warm radial wash with blurred blobs, a stack of soft white rounded accordion cards (one pre-opened, lifting on a coral glow with its icon tile swapping to the gradient via a grid-template-rows CSS reveal), a bold full-bleed sunset-gradient CTA card with a frosted-dark reassurance pill, and a minimal cream footer.
prompt:
## Resumo A warm, friendly FAQ / help-center landing section built around a soft sunset-gradient palette. A sticky blurred cream nav (a gradient sparkle-square logo + 'Promptcraft' wordmark, Library / Showcase / Pricing / FAQ links, a gradient 'Start free' pill) sits over a centered hero: a white 'FAQ & HELP CENTER' pill, a huge two-line headline 'Got questions?' / 'We've got answers.' (the second line filled with a coral->amber gradient text clip), and a lead with a 'Talk to a human.' underline link, all over a warm radial-gradient header band with soft blurred coral/amber blobs. Below, a vertically stacked accordion of white rounded cards, each with a rounded square icon tile + question + a rotating caret, where the open card lifts on a soft coral shadow and its icon tile fills with the gradient. The section closes with a bold full-width sunset-gradient CTA card ('Still have questions?', a frosted-dark sub-pill, a white 'Contact support' button + an outline 'Browse docs' button) and a minimal cream footer with the gradient logo + social icons. ## Estilo Visual Design a warm, friendly, optimistic SaaS FAQ / help-center page. Base background is cream #fdf8f3; primary text is warm near-black ink #1c140e; secondary text is muted brown #6c5d52 (and a softer #8a7c70). Build ONE accent system from a sunset gradient: coral #ff6b4a -> amber #ffb020 (linear ~100-120deg), with a deeper coral #cf3a13 for links and a hotter #f7572e -> #ff7a3a -> #ff9d18 for the big CTA card. Spend that gradient deliberately: as -webkit-background-clip:text gradient text on the second headline line, as the fill of rounded logo / pill tiles ('grad-pill'), as the fill of an open FAQ card's icon tile, and as one full-bleed rounded-[28px] CTA card ('grad-cta'). Surfaces are soft: white #ffffff cards with hairline border-ink/8, faint warm shadows (e.g. shadow 0 2px 10px -6px rgba(28,20,14,0.18)), big rounding (rounded-2xl cards, rounded-full pills). Add atmosphere with a layered warm header wash ('grad-warm': a vertical amber 0.10->0 fade plus two radial coral/amber glows top-left and top-right) and large pointer-events-none blurred color blobs (bg-coral/10 and bg-amber/15, blur-3xl). Set all type in Plus Jakarta Sans (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800), antialiased, text-rendering optimizeLegibility, smooth scroll; display headlines are extrabold with tracking -0.02em and tight 1.05 leading, body is 15-18px relaxed-leading muted. Accordion motion: details>summary with the marker removed, the answer wrapped in a grid that transitions grid-template-rows 0fr->1fr over 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); a caret that rotates 180deg over 0.3s on open; and on [open] the card border tints coral/30 with a soft coral drop-shadow and the icon tile swaps to the gradient fill with white icon. Keep it warm, human and a touch playful, never clinical. ## Layout e Estrutura ### Sticky nav A sticky top-0 z-50 header with a cream #fdf8f3 at ~80% opacity background, a backdrop-filter saturate(160%) blur(14px) ('nav-blur'), and a hairline border-b border-ink/5. Inside, a max-w-[1180px] mx-auto px-6 sm:px-8 flex row at h-[68px], items centered, justify-between. Left: a brand lockup = a 36px (h-9 w-9) rounded-xl gradient ('grad-pill', coral->amber) tile with a white sparkle icon (ph:sparkle-fill, ~20px) and a soft coral drop-shadow, beside a 19px extrabold 'Promptcraft' wordmark with tight tracking. Center (hidden below md): nav links 'Library / Showcase / Pricing / FAQ' at 15px, 500 weight, in muted ink #6c5d52, hovering to full ink, with 'FAQ' already active (full ink). Right: a 'Sign in' text link (hidden on mobile, 15px 600 muted->ink) and a 'Start free' pill = rounded-full gradient ('grad-pill') fill, white 14px 600 text, px-5 py-2.5, a soft coral shadow, brightness-105 on hover. ### Hero header band A relative overflow-hidden section (id=faq). Layer a warm gradient wash absolutely across the top 460px ('grad-warm': a vertical rgba(255,176,32,0.10)->0 fade plus two radial glows, coral rgba(255,107,74,0.22) top-left and amber rgba(255,176,32,0.26) top-right), plus two large pointer-events-none blurred blobs (a 288px coral/10 blob nudged off the left edge, an 320px amber/15 blob off the right). Inside a relative max-w-[1180px] px-6 sm:px-8 pt-20 md:pt-24, center a max-w-[760px] text-center column: an inline-flex 'FAQ & HELP CENTER' eyebrow pill (rounded-full, border-coral/25, bg-white/70, 13px 600, tracking-wide, coral text, a small ph:question-fill icon, a soft shadow); a huge h1 at 44px / sm:56px / md:64px, extrabold, leading-1.05, tracking -0.02em reading 'Got questions?' on line one and 'We've got answers.' on line two where the second line is gradient-clipped text ('grad-text', coral->amber); and a max-w-[560px] mt-6 lead at 17-18px, relaxed leading, in muted ink #6c5d52, ending with a 'Talk to a human.' inline link in deeper coral #cf3a13 with a 2px coral/40 underline offset-4 that darkens on hover. ### Accordion list (closed cards) A mx-auto mt-14 sm:mt-16 max-w-[820px] vertical stack with space-y-3.5 of
cards. Each card: rounded-2xl, white #ffffff, a hairline border-ink/8, px-5 sm:px-6 py-1, a faint warm shadow (0 2px 10px -6px rgba(28,20,14,0.18)), transition-colors. The (marker removed via list-style:none + ::-webkit-details-marker hidden, cursor pointer) is a flex items-start gap-4 py-5 row: a 36px (h-9 w-9) rounded-xl 'qico' icon tile (border-ink/8, bg-cream, coral icon, a relevant Phosphor bold icon per question, e.g. ph:books-bold, ph:plugs-connected-bold, ph:credit-card-bold, ph:export-bold, ph:users-three-bold); a flex-1 question at 17-18px, bold, leading-snug, full ink; and a 20px caret (ph:caret-down-bold, the 'chev', muted ink) that transitions transform 0.3s. The answer is wrapped as
...
where .ans is a grid with grid-template-rows:0fr transitioning 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) and the inner div is overflow-hidden, so closed cards hide their answer. Answer copy is a p with pb-5 pl-[52px] pr-2 (indented to align under the question, past the icon), 15.5px, relaxed leading, muted ink. ### Accordion open / active state Ship the FIRST card ('What exactly does Promptcraft do?') pre-opened with the open attribute. When details.faq is [open]: the answer grid transitions grid-template-rows to 1fr (revealing the paragraph), the caret 'chev' rotates 180deg, the card border tints to coral/30 with a soft coral drop-shadow (box-shadow 0 16px 40px -20px rgba(255,107,74,0.50)) so the open card lifts, and the icon tile 'qico' fills with the coral->amber gradient with a white icon and transparent border. Only styling/state changes, layout stays put; native
handles toggling (multiple can open). ### Gradient CTA card A mx-auto mt-16 sm:mt-20 max-w-[940px] block (id=contact) holding one bold full-bleed CTA card: a relative overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] 'grad-cta' (linear 125deg #f7572e -> #ff7a3a -> #ff9d18) with px-8 py-12 / sm:px-14 sm:py-16, center text, and a big soft coral drop-shadow (0 30px 70px -30px rgba(247,87,46,0.75)). Add contrast/texture overlays: a from-black/0 via-black/5 to-black/25 vertical gradient and two blurred white/10-15 blobs in opposite corners. Centered content (relative): a 56px (h-14 w-14) rounded-2xl white/20 ring-1 ring-white/30 backdrop-blur tile with a white ph:chats-circle-fill icon; an extrabold white h2 at 30px / sm:36px 'Still have questions?'; a frosted dark sub-line as an inline-block rounded-2xl bg-black/40 ring-1 ring-white/10 backdrop-blur px-5 py-3, 16-17px medium white, max-w-[520px], reading the warm-friend reassurance 'Our team actually answers, real humans, fast replies. Ping us and we'll sort it out together.'; and a mt-8 button row (flex-col on mobile -> sm:flex-row, gap-3): a primary white rounded-full 'Contact support' button (15px bold ink, a ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill icon, shadow-lg) and a secondary outline button (border-white/70, bg-black/40, backdrop-blur, white 15px bold) 'Browse docs' with a trailing ph:arrow-up-right-bold icon. ### Footer A mt-20 footer with a border-t border-ink/8. Inside a max-w-[1180px] mx-auto px-6 sm:px-8 py-10 flex column (sm:flex-row), items-center, justify-between, gap-4, 14px muted ink: left a brand lockup (a 28px h-7 w-7 rounded-lg 'grad-pill' tile with a white sparkle icon + a bold ink 'Promptcraft'); center a copyright line '© 2026 Promptcraft. Design at the speed of thought.'; right a row of three social icon links (ph:x-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:discord-logo-bold, ~19px) that tint coral on hover. ## Componentes Especiais de UI ### Componente Sunset gradient accent system: a single coral #ff6b4a -> amber #ffb020 gradient reused as gradient-clipped headline text ('grad-text'), as the fill of rounded logo / 'Start free' / footer pill tiles ('grad-pill'), as an open FAQ card's icon-tile fill, and as one full-bleed CTA card ('grad-cta', the hotter #f7572e->#ff7a3a->#ff9d18 variant) ### Componente Warm atmospheric background: a layered 'grad-warm' header wash (a vertical amber fade + two radial coral/amber glows) plus large pointer-events-none blurred coral/amber blobs (blur-3xl) for soft depth behind the hero ### Componente Native

style.description: A warm, optimistic, friendly-SaaS aesthetic on a cream #fdf8f3 base with near-black warm ink #1c140e text and muted brown #6c5d52 secondary text. Surfaces are soft and rounded: white #ffffff cards with very light ink/8 borders and faint warm shadows (no hard lines), generous rounding (rounded-2xl cards, rounded-full pills, a rounded-[28px] CTA), and warm radial / layered gradient wash backgrounds plus large blurred color blobs for depth. Type is set entirely in Plus Jakarta Sans (weights 400-800), tracking tight on display (-0.02em), with extrabold huge headlines and relaxed-leading muted body. Motion is gentle and delightful: a 0.32s cubic-bezier grid-template-rows accordion, a 0.3s caret rotate, an open-card coral glow + gradient icon swap. The result feels human, reassuring and a little playful, not corporate or clinical.
